title: 3D Non-Harmonic Saddle Sheet Barycentric Interpolation
intuition: Tests 2D simplex interpolation: learns 24 zero-sigma particles on a curved 3D saddle surface w = 0.8(x^2 - y^2) + 0.9 cos(0.75 pi x) cos(0.75 pi y) and scores unseen k-NN triangle barycenters on surface MAE and novelty.
failure_mode: Discrete-atlas granularity pulls triangle barycenters off the curved saddle sheet (a documented Law 1 trade-off where smooth continuous transport outperforms discrete prototype charts).
protocol_notes: Tier-2 stretch task and Four Laws Adherence Law 1 anchor (24 zero-sigma particles).
